svg.title: Every shaped condition was verified, before and after each sub-block
svg.desc: Two scatter panels over all G2 v2+ network probes. Left: achieved receiver rate as a fraction of the target rate. Right: echo RTT minus the target RTT. Tolerance bands shaded.
svg.text: Every shaped condition was verified, before and after each sub-block
G2 v2+, 196 sub-blocks × pre and post probes (392 probes; rate in both directions). Shaded: the protocol's tolerance; none outside it.
